source: Research overview supplied by Pratikshya Regmi, 2026-10-07.
tagline: I study how extreme events, especially hurricanes, change landscapes and forests using geospatial data.
methods: I combine LiDAR data, drone imagery, satellite imagery, and geospatial modeling to measure changes in terrain, water flow, and forest structure.
focus: My current work focuses on Hurricane Helene’s impacts in western North Carolina, connecting detailed observations of landscape change with questions about recovery, future hazards, and ecosystem resilience.
description: Pratikshya Regmi studies extreme events, landscape change, and forest recovery using LiDAR data, drone imagery, satellite imagery, and geospatial modeling.
selectedIntro: Selected case studies showing how I turn geospatial data into evidence, tools, and insight.
projectsIntro: Research on landscape change, forest resistance and recovery, and the geospatial methods used to study them.
